name: Daily notes and attachments
summary: Daily site notes per structure with photos, audio and positions, and the attachments on notes.

roles.note: The seed catalog has no daily-note permission strings.

nfr.statement: How long daily-note media and deleted attachments are kept in storage.
nfr.open_question: Deleting an attachment removes its record. Must the stored file also go, and on what schedule?

requirements.title: One daily note per exact date and structure
requirements.statement: Submitting a daily note returns the existing one if a note with the exact same date value and structure exists; otherwise a new one is created. An empty batch is rejected.
open_checks: The match uses the exact timestamp, not the day, and ignores deleted notes; no guarantee against concurrent duplicates is shown

acceptance_criteria.given: A daily note for structure S at 2026-03-04T00:00Z
acceptance_criteria.when: Another is submitted for S with the same timestamp

requirements.title: Daily-note positions are worked out after creation
requirements.statement: A daily note's sheet position is its normalised position times the sheet size (1 if unknown). A global position is added when the design has a transform. Both are written after the note is created, so they may appear a moment later.

acceptance_criteria.given: A daily note at normalised (0.5, 0.5) on a 1000 × 800 sheet

requirements.title: Daily-note attachments are created once
requirements.statement: When a daily note's upload completes, a claim flag makes sure only one request creates its attachments. If any attachment already exists, none are created. Audio is translated in the background.
open_checks: Claiming first prevents duplicates but skips recovery if attachment creation fails halfway

acceptance_criteria.given: Two completion calls arrive for the same daily note

requirements.title: Deleting an attachment removes its record
requirements.statement: Deleting an attachment permanently removes its record, unlike notes, which are only marked deleted.

acceptance_criteria.then: Its record is gone; the response reports how many were deleted
